build.//: `medusa build` emits a STANDALONE app into .medusa/server with its own package.json. That directory is what runs in production — starting from apps/backend instead fails with 'Could not find index.html in the admin build directory'. It needs its own production install.
build.buildCommand: npm run build && cd .medusa/server && npm install --omit=dev --legacy-peer-deps

deploy.//: Migrations run before the new container takes traffic, not at boot, so a failed migration doesn't half-start the app.
